review_fixes.change: NativeAttackCommand::store_route_state publishes the typed tick result to native offsets +24h/+28h immediately after ai_command_tick_vt000c reports a route pass. It verifies the CAUTIOUSATTACK class and owner before writing; promotion replaces the old native command, so CLOSEATTACK is never written through the route view. The existing chain544 switch guards the new host-side publication.
review_fixes.verification: The lifetime fixture runs the existing ai_cautious_approach_pass_00a14dd0 against a single-leader route fixture. It builds three route points plus the destination, changes the flag false -> true and counter 4 -> 3, calls the production store_command_route_state helper, and verifies the same true/3 values through both NativeAttackCommand::state() and raw bytes +24h/+28h. Subsequent retargeting still resets route state to false/4.

Complete chain541's constructor/projection selection before chain544's installation switch, so both the constructor result and its old fallback pass through replace_command when chain544 is ON.
